assertion: A newly allocated terminal tab ID is not evidence that a PTY already exists.
Visible xterm readiness opens once per bound terminal generation.
Hiding a terminal panel disposes rendering without falsely reporting backend shutdown.
Bounded in-memory output is not a durable transcript and is not silently reused across identities.
Reader-driven terminal-exit cannot become an execution-success event.
Tab removal before unawaited backend close preserves visible close-failure diagnosis.
Manual restart failure clears pending launch and prevents unintended stdin write.
Single-script ready gating proves write targeting, not script exit or success.
Multiple launch IDs retain independent pending writes and failure toasts.
Setup marker creation must not inherit the semantics of manual launch completion.
Ephemeral tab state and persistent backend resources have different restart behavior.
Focus/visible refresh failure cannot certify the stale closure workspace set as current.
Visible remote workspace polling is sealed independently of connect buttons.
DOM and Tauri focus-triggered connect/resume routes cannot restore sealed remote behavior.
Thread polling uses explicit live/processing state and is not a server lease.
Unsubscribe failure followed by subscribe cannot be represented as an atomic switch.
Late detach within or after the ten-second window cannot revive an old binding.
Blur/hidden cleanup records uncertain unsubscribe rather than confirmed server removal.
Connected notifications may reconnect live subscriptions and are not badge-only events.
Activity/heartbeat display does not certify subscription continuity or absence of gaps.
Notification deep-link replacement/expiry and failed connect must preserve target scope.
Ignored Tauri emit failure cannot be promoted to delivered event.
Raw workspace/thread identity requires public binding generation and sequence provenance.
Initial native-listen failure and later subscribers require explicit retry/error attribution.
Unsubscribe before async listen completion must clean up without claiming buffered delivery.
Two semantic hubs for the same native event must not cause duplicate execution or notifications.
Raw events reach debug before supported-method filtering and require redaction.
Missing approval IDs or empty questions must not create fabricated actionable continuations.
Malformed camel/snake event fields are diagnosed rather than silently becoming completion.
Unsupported events remain diagnosable but never authorize unknown actions.
Native background-thread hiding is not a public seat lifecycle or task completion.
Archive cascades preserve per-descendant partial failures and do not delete original history.
Account/connected events cause native refresh and invalidate the correct capability identity only.
Agent deltas and completed messages retain distinct activity/unread rules.
Active thread ID alone cannot clear unread across windows, projects or read versions.
Stale turn errors do not alter current unread or active execution state.
Thread start/activity naming does not implicitly mark unread or create public subagent authority.
Plan delta, native complete status and Plan-ready notification remain separate facts.
Completion notification duration/focus/dedup gates must not leak private reply excerpts.
Reordered item-complete/turn-complete events do not double-notify or lose unread state.
Sound notification success is independent of system-notification success.
Approval notification dedup keys include the correct request generation and scope.
Question notification text and metadata are redacted independently of spacing retries.
Queued plan notices are ephemeral and must not assert durable execution history.
Sound and system subagent filters are separately preserved or explicitly reconciled.
Permission denial and fallback failure must not be represented as visible notification delivery.
A deep link recorded before notify attempt is not evidence the user saw a notification.
AudioContext resume/fetch/decode/start and autoplay/device failures are separately reported.
Copy-thread exports the selected transcript only; clipboard acceptance is not Delivery.
OS drop paths flow through native and browser consumers with target and generation validation.
